title: Recite 100 times between Nafilah Fajr and Namaz of Fajr سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيْمِ
data:
Eleventh: In his book of al-’Arus, Shaykh Ja’far ibn Ahmad al-Qummi has recorded that Imam al-Sadiq(a.s.) is reported to have said that one who repeats the following zikr one hundred times between the dawn (fajr) supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) and obligatory prayers will be owned, by Almighty Allah, a house in Paradise:
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهٖ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ رَبِّيْ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ.
SUBHAANA RABBIYAL 'AZEEMI WA BIHAMDIHEE ASTAGHFIRUL LAAHA RABBEE WA ATOOBU ILAYH.
Glory be to my Lord, the Great, and praise be to Him. I seek the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, and I turn to Him in repentance.
